name: Twistlock
description: Twistlock is a cloud native cybersecurity platform for hosts, containers, and serverless setups that ensures the protection of all your workloads across any environment. The Sumo Logic App for Twistlock provides comprehensive monitoring and analysis solution for detecting vulnerabilities and potential threats throughout your environment, including hosts and containers.

children.name: Twistlock - CVE Status
children.description: The Twistlock - CVE Status dashboard combines high-level views of common vulnerabilities and exposures (CVE) along with detailed information. Panels display at-a-glance views for host, image, and registry scans, and available fixes. Detailed information on host, image scan, and registry scan CVEs is shown in separate panels, as well as identified time comparison CVEs on hosts, images, and registry.
